items.headline: Connelly on Week 10: His 14 favorite games on loaded schedule
items.description: The Week 10 schedule is the most anticipated of the season. Here are the keys to all the major matchups.

items.headline: Army matches up against Air Force in Week 10
items.description: Air Force (6-2) at Army (5-3), Nov. 7 at 7:30 p.m. EST.

items.headline: Kemper Hodges' 4 TDs lead Air Force ground attack in 35-26 win over UConn
items.description: — Kemper Hodges rushed for 200 yards and four touchdowns as Air Force, once again, leaned on its ground game to hold off UConn 35-26 on Saturday.

items.headline: UCF's, Air Force's space-themed threads lead best uniforms of CFB Week 9
items.description: Nebraska is also going with an all-black look in theme with the Cornhuskers' Saturday game occurring on Halloween.

items.headline: Air Force hosts UConn in Week 9
items.description: UConn (4-3) at Air Force (5-2), Oct. 31 at 3 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Tyler Hughes throws 2 TD passes, runs for score in Wyoming's 28-14 victory over Air Force
items.description: — Tyler Hughes finished with two touchdown passes and a touchdown run to propel Wyoming to a 28-14 victory over the Air Force Academy on Friday night.
